description: This Java source file defines the EwayServices class, providing methods for processing payments, refunds, and releases via the eWAY payment gateway within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for charging, refunding, and releasing transactions, as well as initializing requests with configuration parameters.

classes.name: EwayServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling eWAY payment gateway operations such as charge, refund, and release within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ewayCharge
methods.description: Processes a payment charge through eWAY, including setting up the request with card and billing info, sending it, and returning the response details.

methods.name: ewayRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund transaction via eWAY, retrieving the original transaction, preparing the request, and returning the result.

methods.name: ewayRelease
methods.description: Releases (refunds) a previously authorized transaction, preparing and sending the request, and returning the outcome.

methods.name: initRequest
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayRequest object with configuration parameters for either a charge or refund operation.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway, either from the database or properties files.
